title: 4 to 7 in IB Computer Science in One Month
summary: IB Computer Science one-month plan: go from a 4 to a 7 with a weekly schedule, high-yield topics, exam technique, and RevisionDojo practice tools.
body_markdown:
If you are sitting on a 4, it can feel like the subject is whispering: *you are not a “CS person.”* That whisper is a lie. In **IB Computer Science** , a 4 often means you understand more than you think, but your marks are leaking through predictable cracks: vague theory answers, half-finished algorithms, and revision that feels busy but does not translate into points.


A month is not a miracle window. It is simply long enough to build momentum, tighten your method, and turn “I kind of get it” into “I can earn marks on demand.” This guide is a one-month playbook to move from a 4 to a 7 in **IB Computer Science** by focusing on high-yield content, timed practice, and feedback loops.


Start here:[IB Computer Science Resources](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-computer-science) . It is the cleanest hub to combine Questionbank practice, Study Notes, Flashcards, AI Chat, Grading tools, Predicted Papers, Mock Exams, and more.


Syntax anxiety vs logic first


### One-month checklist (keep it painfully simple)


-


Pick your tools: **Study Notes + Questionbank + Flashcards** (minimum viable stack for IB Computer Science).


-


Decide your daily budget: 2 hours on weekdays, 3-4 on weekends.


-


Diagnose quickly: are you weaker in programming logic or structured theory?


-


Plan four weekly cycles: learn, then practise, review, and retest.
